body:
I was prescribed Chantix to help me quit smoking.  This is a partial nicotine agonist.  I decided to see if it had any abuse potential.  I ingested 2.5mg of it, in .5mg pills, and drank plenty of fluid, to avoid the nausea and vomiting which can occur.
At around +1:00hr I noticed effects starting to hit me.  I felt a bit more tired and felt.. a unique high.  I can't remember the times throughout the day, but I was launched into a high that reminded me of heroin, as I'd nod out as I was doing tasks, like peeling potatoes and washing dishes, but the cook at the diner I work at, asked me if I was on cocaine, because of appearing paranoid and having a runny nose (runny nose due to weather changing).
